sources.label: Waverley Council — Resident Parking Scheme, North Bondi

blocks.text: Everyone assumes you have to pay to park at Bondi. You don't — and this is the local trick I pass on to every visiting friend: skip the meters on Campbell Parade and park for free in the residential streets north of Blair Street.

items.label: Where
items.value: North of Blair Street, North Bondi

blocks.text: Blair Street sits at the northern end of Bondi, near the corner of Warners Avenue, where the land begins to climb toward Ben Buckler — the headland at the top of Bondi Bay. Punch "Blair Street" into your maps app, then head north and uphill, away from the water, and start looking. On the quieter blocks up here the parking is free and unrestricted around the clock: no meters, no time limits.

On weekdays there are spaces until late afternoon, when residents start arriving home from work. Weekends are busier, but the constant coming and going means a patient loop of the block usually turns something up — much more easily if you're early.

From about 9am on a Saturday or Sunday, parking anywhere near Bondi becomes a genuine challenge. Beat the rush: get here early, grab a free spot north of Blair Street, and enjoy a quiet morning on the sand before the crowds roll in.

blocks.title: Read the signs — not every street is free
blocks.text: Waverley Council runs a resident parking scheme across parts of North Bondi, with 2-hour limits and "Permit Holders Excepted" signs on streets including the north side of Blair Street, Wairoa Avenue and Gould Street. Those blocks aren't free for visitors, so keep going until the restrictions drop off, and always check the sign on the pole before you walk away.

items.q: Where is the free parking at Bondi Beach?
items.a: The unsigned residential streets north of Blair Street in North Bondi, heading uphill away from the beach toward Ben Buckler. Where there are no time-limit or permit signs it's free and unrestricted 24 hours, roughly a 5–7 minute walk to the sand.

items.q: What time should I arrive for a free spot?
items.a: Before 9am on weekends. Weekdays are easier until the late afternoon, when residents return home from work.

items.q: Are the streets near Bondi Beach permit-only?
items.a: Some are. Waverley Council's North Bondi resident parking scheme puts 2-hour limits with resident exemptions on certain streets, so read every sign — but plenty of unrestricted street parking remains a few blocks further north.
